Sapiensa begins the battle unable to see or hear any other creatures, unable to be seen or heard by any creature, and unable to take any actions. Once any of her allies is reduced to 0 Hit Points, Sapiensa becomes able to see and hear all other creatures, can be seen and heard by other creatures, and can, at the start of the next round, begin taking actions. 
When Sapiensa or one of her allies are reduced to 0 Hit Points, Sapiensa activates the following abilities (after the damage has been resolved), based on which character has been defeated:
⬥ **Audacia**: Sapiensa deals 40 **light** damage to every enemy she can see, and Sapiensa and all allies she can see treats their **Might** as being one die size higher until the end of the scene (up to a maximum of **d12**).
⬥ **Carita**: Sapiensa, and all allies Sapiensa can see, have all damage they suffer reduced by **10** (**before** applying Affinities).
⬥ **Clementia**: Sapiensa, and all allies Sapiensa can see, become **Immune** to **poisoned** and their Affinity for **ice** damage becomes Immunity.
⬥ **Justicia**: Sapiensa deals 40 **light** damage to every enemy she can see, and Sapiensa and all allies she can see treats their **Insight** as being one die size higher until the end of the scene (up to a maximum of **d12**).
⬥ **Laetitia**: Each ally remaining on the scene immediately performs the following actions (if able), waving all Mind Point costs: Audacia performs **High Jump** (If not **Airborne**), or **Comet Impact**. Carita casts **Overshell** on one random ally, prioritizing allies who are **not** already under the effects of **Overshell**. Clementia casts **Stigmata** on one creature, prioritizing creatures **not** already under the effects of **Stigmata**. Justitia casts **Just Cry** on every ally she can see. Sapiensa performs **Goddesses' Will**.
⬥ **Sapiensa**: Sapeiensa activates the effects that trigger on an ally being reduced to 0 Hit Points for each ally that is still in the scene, in alphabetical order.

Ser Keldon is the son of an *Ascendant* noble,  and he follows the ideals of *The Ascendancy* to their utmost extremes, believing it is his duty as a “Climber” to impose hardship and sacrifice onto the peasantry, to “forge their resolve” and “allow them the chance to climb to perfection”.
Currently serving as the *Captain of the City Guard* in **Pierce**,  he will engage with any groups that cause trouble within the city, and will crush any public dissent.
There are rumors that Keldon is the reincarnation of an ancient hero, and he has fully adopted this into his personality.  He believes he is **the** good guy, one of the greatest *ever,* and that his path and his ideals will undoubtedly lead him to becoming a perfect soul.

Every round Keldon performs the following actions in order, targeting the strongest party member:
1.  Hero's Sword or Might of the Hero

3. Transform his weapon into the **Hero's Blade**

spells.effect:
Once cast **Honey B. Live** gives all player characters a **Heart Clock** with segments equal to their WLP Dice (6 for d6,  8 for d8 etc).  A player's **Heart Clock** always fills by one segment when they take damage from Honey B.  If the clock segments are all filled the player character tied to it must do one of the following actions on their turn, chosen randomly with a D6:

**1.** Spend **3 IP** to give Honey B an Elixir. If you don't have enough IP you instead lose half of your current MP
**2.** Use the Equip Action to equip a pair of *Honey B Glowsticks*, two Improvised (Melee) weapons that will break after one attack. If you can't equip weapons you instead lose half of your current MP
**3.** Use the Equip Action to equip an official *Honey B T-Shirt*, No Armor. If you can't equip armour you instead lose half of your current MP
**4.** Use the Equip Action to equip a *Honey B Fanclub Badge* accessory that does nothing, If you can't equip accessories you instead lose half of your current MP
**5.** Use the Objective Action to give Honey B half of your current Zenit
**6.** Take the guard action and **cover** Honey B.

After the action the clock goes back down to having 0 segments filled.

A DL 13 Objective action can remove this Clock if it has no segments filled. **Dispel** Can also remove a **Heart Clock** applied by **Honey B. Live**
